result.instructions: Tools for Lexware Office, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Lexware Office data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run lexware_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run lexware_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run lexware_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. lexware_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: lexware_get_profile
tools.title: Get the company profile
tools.description: The connected Lexware Office organization: organizationId, company name, the user who created the API key, tax type (net/gross/vatfree), small-business flag (Kleinunternehmer), distance-sales principle and the plan's business features (INVOICING, INVOICING_PRO, BOOKKEEPING). Good first call. GET /v1/profile.

tools.name: lexware_list_contacts
tools.title: List or search contacts
tools.description: List customers and vendors, optionally filtered (filters combine with AND). name and email match as case-insensitive substrings (at least 3 characters; _ and % are wildcards). Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /v1/contacts.

name.description: Part of the contact's name (min 3 characters).

email.description: Part of any of the contact's email addresses (min 3 characters).

customer.description: true = only contacts with the customer role, false = only contacts without it.

vendor.description: true = only contacts with the vendor role, false = only contacts without it.

page.description: Page index, 0-based (default 0). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: lexware_list_articles
tools.title: List articles
tools.description: List articles (products and services usable as invoice line items), with price, tax rate and unit. Optional exact filters by article number, GTIN or type. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /v1/articles.

page.description: Page index, 0-based (default 0). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: lexware_list_vouchers
tools.title: List vouchers (invoices, quotations, receipts...)
tools.description: Search the voucher list: metadata (id, type, status, number, dates, contact, total and open amount) of sales documents (invoice, quotation, creditnote, orderconfirmation, deliverynote, downpaymentinvoice) and bookkeeping vouchers (salesinvoice, salescreditnote, purchaseinvoice, purchasecreditnote). Omit voucher_types / voucher_statuses for all. Then fetch details with the matching get tool (invoice → lexware_get_invoice, quotation → lexware_get_quotation, creditnote → lexware_get_credit_note, orderconfirmation → lexware_get_order_confirmation, deliverynote → lexware_get_delivery_note, downpaymentinvoice → lexware_get_down_payment_invoice, the four bookkeeping types → lexware_get_bookkeeping_voucher). Dates are yyyy-mm-dd, whole days in German time. Up to 10,000 results can be paged through; narrow the dates for more. GET /v1/voucherlist.

voucher_statuses.description: Statuses to include (default: all). overdue cannot be combined with other statuses; accepted/rejected apply to quotations, unchecked to bookkeeping vouchers.

archived.description: true = only archived, false = only not archived.

page.description: Page index, 0-based (default 0). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: lexware_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id: status (draft/open/paid/voided), line items, totals, tax amounts, payment and shipping conditions, related vouchers. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_quotation
tools.title: Get a quotation
tools.description: Get one quotation by id: status (draft/open/accepted/rejected), expiration date, line items, totals. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/quotations/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_credit_note
tools.title: Get a credit note
tools.description: Get one credit note by id: status, line items, totals, related invoice. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/credit-notes/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_order_confirmation
tools.title: Get an order confirmation
tools.description: Get one order confirmation by id: status, line items, totals, delivery terms. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/order-confirmations/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_delivery_note
tools.title: Get a delivery note
tools.description: Get one delivery note by id: status, line items, shipping conditions. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/delivery-notes/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_down_payment_invoice
tools.title: Get a down payment invoice
tools.description: Get one down payment invoice (Abschlagsrechnung) by id: status, amounts, related closing invoice. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/down-payment-invoices/{id}.

id.description: The down payment invoice id (from lexware_list_vouchers).

tools.name: lexware_get_dunning
tools.title: Get a dunning
tools.description: Get one dunning (payment reminder) by id: status, the dunned invoice in relatedVouchers, line items, totals. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/dunnings/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_bookkeeping_voucher
tools.title: Get a bookkeeping voucher
tools.description: Get one bookkeeping voucher (salesinvoice, salescreditnote, purchaseinvoice or purchasecreditnote from the voucher list) by id: status, voucher items with posting category ids, tax amounts, contact, file ids. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/vouchers/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_article
tools.title: Get an article
tools.description: Get one article (product or service) by id: title, type, article number, GTIN, unit, net/gross price and tax rate. GET /v1/articles/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact (customer and/or vendor) by id: customer/vendor numbers, company or person, contact persons, addresses, emails, phones, note. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_payments
tools.title: Get a voucher's payments
tools.description: Payment status of an invoice, credit note, down payment invoice or bookkeeping voucher: open amount, payment status (balanced/openRevenue/openExpense), paid date and the payment items (bank transactions, cash, credit notes, Skonto). Not available for quotations or drafts. GET /v1/payments/{voucherId}.

tools.name: lexware_list_countries
tools.title: List countries
tools.description: Countries known to Lexware Office with their code, English and German name and tax classification (de, intraCommunity, thirdPartyCountry). GET /v1/countries.

tools.name: lexware_list_payment_conditions
tools.title: List payment conditions
tools.description: The payment conditions configured in Lexware Office (days until due, early-payment discount, label template, which is the organization default). GET /v1/payment-conditions.

tools.name: lexware_list_posting_categories
tools.title: List posting categories
tools.description: Bookkeeping posting categories (id, name, group, income or outgo, whether a contact is required and split tax rates are allowed), used by bookkeeping vouchers' categoryId. Optionally only income or outgo. GET /v1/posting-categories.

tools.name: lexware_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new customer and/or vendor in Lexware Office (Lexware assigns the customer/vendor number). Give company_name for a company OR person_last_name for a private person. One billing and one shipping address, one email and one phone at most. Check lexware_list_contacts first to avoid duplicates. POST /v1/contacts.

roles.description: Roles of the new contact (default customer).

contact_person_last_name.description: Company: last name of the (primary) contact person.

person_salutation.description: Private person: salutation, e.g. Frau, Herr.

country_code.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, AT, CH (lexware_list_countries lists the supported codes).
ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, AT, CH (lexware_list_countries lists the supported codes).

xrechnung_vendor_number_at_customer.description: Your vendor number at that customer (with the Leitweg-ID).

tools.name: lexware_create_draft_invoice
tools.title: Create a draft invoice
tools.description: WRITE: creates an invoice in Lexware Office as a DRAFT (never finalized, numbered or sent; Lexware assigns the number when the user finalizes it in the app). Address it to an existing customer (contact_id) or a one-time address (name + country_code). Prices are EUR. Returns the new id and lexwareAppUrl to review and finalize it in Lexware Office. POST /v1/invoices (without finalize).

contact_id.description: An existing Lexware contact with the customer role (from lexware_list_contacts). Give this OR name + country_code.

name.description: One-time recipient name (no contact is created). Required without contact_id.

country_code.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, AT, CH (lexware_list_countries lists the supported codes).

shipping_type.description: Leistungs-/Lieferdatum type: service or delivery (needs shipping_date), serviceperiod or deliveryperiod (needs shipping_date and shipping_end_date), none.

shipping_date.description: Service/delivery date, or the start of the period (yyyy-mm-dd).

language.description: Document language (default de; en needs the INVOICING_PRO feature).

tax_type.description: Tax type (default net): net, gross, vatfree, intraCommunitySupply, constructionService13b, externalService13b, thirdPartyCountryService, thirdPartyCountryDelivery.

tax_type_note.description: Note for a vat-free tax type (Lexware uses the organization's default when omitted).

type.description: custom = a free item without an article; service/material = an existing article (article_id required); text = a text-only line.

article_id.description: The article id (from lexware_list_articles); required for type service and material, not allowed otherwise.

description.description: Item description (max 2000; **bold**, __italic__ and '- ' lists are supported).

quantity.description: Quantity (up to 4 decimals); required unless type is text.

unit_name.description: Unit, e.g. Stück, Stunde, piece, hour; required unless type is text.

unit_price.description: Unit price in EUR (up to 4 decimals): NET when tax_type is not gross, GROSS when tax_type is gross. Required unless type is text.

tax_rate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. 19, 7 or 0 (0 for every vat-free tax_type). Required unless type is text.

discount_percentage.description: Line discount in percent (up to 2 decimals).

payment_term_duration.description: Days until payment is due (the organization's or contact's default when omitted).

payment_term_label.description: Payment terms text shown on the document.

title.description: Document title (max 25 characters; default from Lexware).

tools.name: lexware_create_draft_quotation
tools.title: Create a draft quotation
tools.description: WRITE: creates a quotation (Angebot) in Lexware Office as a DRAFT (never finalized or sent). Address it to an existing customer (contact_id) or a one-time address (name + country_code). Prices are EUR. Returns the new id and lexwareAppUrl to review and finalize it in Lexware Office. POST /v1/quotations (without finalize).

contact_id.description: An existing Lexware contact with the customer role (from lexware_list_contacts). Give this OR name + country_code.

name.description: One-time recipient name (no contact is created). Required without contact_id.

country_code.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, AT, CH (lexware_list_countries lists the supported codes).

expiration_date.description: Valid until (yyyy-mm-dd), on or after voucher_date.

language.description: Document language (default de; en needs the INVOICING_PRO feature).

tax_type.description: Tax type (default net): net, gross, vatfree, intraCommunitySupply, constructionService13b, externalService13b, thirdPartyCountryService, thirdPartyCountryDelivery.

tax_type_note.description: Note for a vat-free tax type (Lexware uses the organization's default when omitted).

type.description: custom = a free item without an article; service/material = an existing article (article_id required); text = a text-only line.

article_id.description: The article id (from lexware_list_articles); required for type service and material, not allowed otherwise.

description.description: Item description (max 2000; **bold**, __italic__ and '- ' lists are supported).

quantity.description: Quantity (up to 4 decimals); required unless type is text.

unit_name.description: Unit, e.g. Stück, Stunde, piece, hour; required unless type is text.

unit_price.description: Unit price in EUR (up to 4 decimals): NET when tax_type is not gross, GROSS when tax_type is gross. Required unless type is text.

tax_rate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. 19, 7 or 0 (0 for every vat-free tax_type). Required unless type is text.

discount_percentage.description: Line discount in percent (up to 2 decimals).

payment_term_duration.description: Days until payment is due (the organization's or contact's default when omitted).

payment_term_label.description: Payment terms text shown on the document.
